subject: Request: Short-term threshold increment + retroactive credit for Sep surge
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@fastretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: 2026-09-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: temporary quota lift for Sep launch traffic

Kimberly —

Quick context: we had a larger-than-expected promo spike this week and have crossed the monthly threshold by ~38%. Our production endpoints are throttled and engineering is asking for an immediate short-term increase for the weekend to avoid degraded customer experiences.

Two asks: (1) Can Redwood provision a +40% headroom for 48 hours (regional: us-east) starting tonight? (2) If we purchase a short-term buffer now, can we get a retroactive credit against the overrun on September invoice (we have a PO in flight)? Procurement needs a price and a simple amendment or statement of work they can attach to the PO.

I attached a summary of the usage spike. Samir

Attachments: usage-2026-09-summary.csv (csv)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@fastretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary quota lift for Sep launch traffic

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. I looped Ben (account lead) and Laura (billing/procurement) to confirm options. Short answer: we can do a provisional 48-hour threshold increment and offer a reconciliation credit if FastRetail commits to a PO for the uplift window. Need to nail a few details:

- Exact uplift target (you asked ~40%) — we'll size the buffer to cover peak QPS and a 10% safety margin. Can you confirm target % or expected peak QPS?
- Legal/procurement path: is procurement able to approve a one-line amendment + PO reference, or do you need a full addendum?
- Billing treatment: Laura, can we apply the provisional uplift as a prepaid short-term slab and then credit any overlap against the overrun on the September invoice?

I propose: provisioning tonight at 7pm PT if we confirm numbers by 4pm PT today. Ben, any pricing guidance for a 48-hour slab and the retroactive credit mechanism?

Thanks — Kim

Signature: Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0112

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T12:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary quota lift for Sep launch traffic

Adding pricing detail — Samir (copied above) so everyone's aligned.

Proposal (48-hour provisional uplift):
- Flat uplift slab: $6,000 for a 48-hour +40% headroom (covers token throughput and burst capacity); invoiced as a prepaid line item.
- Retro credit: if FastRetail provides a PO referencing this uplift within 72 hours and signs the one-page amendment, we'll credit up to the prepaid amount against the overrun on the Sept invoice (one-time credit, not recurring). Excess usage beyond the slab will be charged at standard overrun rates.
- Procurement paperwork: we'll supply a short amendment (1 page) + invoice/receipt for the prepaid slab. Laura, can you prepare the amendment and a simple invoice template we can hand to Samir?

Operational notes:
- Engineering: we'll route requests to the dedicated headroom pool for the uplift window; no model swap required.
- Monitoring: set an alert to auto-scale down after 48 hours.

Kimberly/Ben: if you want margins softened for retention, we can do $5,000 if they commit to a 3-month minimum after the month ends. But for an emergency we should keep the path simple.

—Ben

Signature: Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@fastretail.com>, procurement@fastretail.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Short-term threshold increment + retroactive credit for Sep surge

Samir — great news: procurement sent the PO this afternoon and copied your legal team. I attached the PO and the 1-page uplift amendment we discussed. Summary of agreed terms: 

- Uplift: +40% headroom for 48 hours starting 2026-09-30T19:00:00-07:00 (us-east).
- Fee: $6,000 prepaid slab, invoice sent on receipt.
- Retro credit: once PO is validated and the amendment is countersigned, Redwood will apply a credit up to $6,000 against the September overrun line item. Any usage beyond the slab will be billed at standard overrun rates.
- Next steps for FastRetail: sign the amendment and return to laura_bennett@redwood.com within 72 hours to qualify for the retroactive credit.

Please see attachment: FastRetail_PO_089.pdf (pdf) and the amendment doc (attached as a drive link). We stood up the uplift in staging and will flip the production headroom at 7pm PT tonight. Ben and Laura will monitor invoice/credit workflow.

On a side note, Ben and I flagged a potential packaging suggestion: consider a small committed safety buffer for high-season accounts to avoid reactive top-ups — happy to discuss in renewal planning.

Thanks, Kim

Attachments: FastRetail_PO_089.pdf (pdf)
